name: Volodymyr Vavrynyuk
summary: A Full-Stack Developer with over 8+ years of experience in web development, specializing in Drupal and Angular. Proficient in building scalable and maintainable applications, with a strong focus on performance and user experience. Experienced in leading projects, mentoring junior developers, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.

projects.title: Wildauto.com.ua
projects.description: WildAuto is an informational website showcasing a wide selection of vehicles available in Ukraine. The site allows users to explore detailed car listings and specification of each car.

lists.title: Problems were solved:
items: Developed a Telegram bot for posting cars to a Telegram channel.
Created a Telegram bot to send notifications after "Contact Us" form submissions.
Built a search page with facet filters for improved content discoverability.
Extended the Better Exposed Filters module to disable auto-submit on mobile devices (https://www.drupal.org/project/better_exposed_filters/issues/3452004).
Implemented GitHub Actions for automated linting and deployment workflows.

projects.title: Ecommerce sites
projects.description: A bunch of e-commerce sites for different clients that were created with Drupal Commerce.

lists.title: Problems were solved:
items: Developed module for creating product bundles: (https://www.drupal.org/project/commerce_bundle_trait).
Built API integrations with external services to manage products, orders, payments, user data, and more.
Created a custom module for Permutive analytics integration.
Implemented a credit system allowing admins to assign credits to users, which are automatically applied to recurring orders to make them free if sufficient credits are available.

projects.title: Church portal
projects.description: A church portal that provides information about the church, its services, and events.

lists.title: Problems were solved:
items: Created a custom Views style plugin to render each content type in its own section.
Attached a “Load More” pager to each individual section for dynamic loading.
Developed an admin interface to configure human-readable section names and weights (ordering).
Integrated sections with facet filters for enhanced filtering across grouped content.

projects.title: Campaign platform
projects.description: A platform for managing campaigns, allowing users to apply to campaigns, verify their email, and log in with a one-time link.

lists.title: Problems were solved:
items: Developed a user application flow allowing each campaign to have its own customizable application form.
Implemented email verification and one-time login functionality after a user applies to a campaign.
Built a Search API view capable of handling dynamic application form data per campaign.
Created functionality to duplicate campaigns, automatically generating all associated landing pages, webforms, and related content.
Extended s3fs_cors file validation by adding custom asynchronous validators (https://www.drupal.org/project/s3fs_cors/issues/3474669)

projects.title: Official website for the city
projects.description: The official website for the city that provides information about the city, its services, and events.

lists.title: Problems were solved:
items: Investigated potential SAML integration approaches for authentication.
Created scripts to automatically convert absolute URLs to relative ones across all text fields and entity types.
Resolved multiple accessibility issues to improve compliance and user experience.
Extended the Domain Redirect module to allow customization of redirect status codes.
Developed a module to determine and resolve the primary menu entry when duplicate links exist.

projects.title: Publication storage and distribution platform
projects.description: A platform for storing and distributing publications, providing a API for searching of publications.

lists.title: Problems were solved:
items: Developed an XML-based migration for importing publication content.
Created an admin-facing Search API view to enable efficient publication searching.
Built a REST API to expose publication search capabilities via custom endpoints.

projects.title: Global Public Health Hub
projects.description: A leading resource for research, education, and insights on global public health issues.

lists.title: Problems were solved:
items: Upgraded Drupal core to version 10, including the Group module from 1.x to 2.x.
Added revision management permissions to group roles.
Implemented per-group configuration to control which content types are displayed in Views.
Developed a feed importer for media items and automated their attachment to related entities after import.

projects.title: BazaIT
projects.description: IT recruiting platform by recruiters for the talents who want to get a new job and grow in Tech. BazaIT creates a network of talented people and IT products.

lists.title: Problems were solved:
items: Implemented a dynamic search page with a programmatically generated search form.
Integrated multiple modules with NgRx for reactive state management.
Developed a dynamic form builder service for generating complex forms at runtime.
Created a utility service to transform UUIDs into readable names and persist data in GET parameters.

projects.title: Sites migration from Episerver to Drupal

Established the site’s content structure.
Configured meta tags, caching, and other performance optimizations.
Developed custom Views plugins for relationships, filters, and sorting.

technologies.description: Expert in modern PHP (OOP, Composer, PSR standards). Developed custom modules, APIs, and integrations for large-scale Drupal and custom projects. Have experience with Symfony and Laravel frameworks.
8+ years of experience with Drupal 8/9/10/11. Site building, custom module/theme development, migrations, performance, and security.
Database design, query optimization, and migrations. Experience with MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL in high-load environments.
Modern JS/TS (ES6+), async/await, SPA development, and integration with REST/GraphQL APIs.
Developed and maintained Angular applications with NgRx, SSR, and Material. Built dynamic forms and state management.
Built and supported React apps with Redux, hooks, and SSR. Experience with component libraries and custom UI logic.
REST API development with Express and NestJS, backend services, and automation scripts.
Responsive layouts with Flexbox/Grid, preprocessors (Sass), and utility-first frameworks (Tailwind).
Proficient in Git workflows, branching strategies, and CI/CD integration (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
